# PaddleBase & PaddleBase Owner

> The unified operating system for Southeast Asian racket sports.

PaddleBase connects recreational and competitive pickleball players, facility operators, coaches, and tournament referees through a single high-performance software ecosystem.

## Core Surfaces
- [Player Discovery & Court Booking](https://paddlebase.org/courts): Browse verified courts in Davao City, Digos, Matanao, Bansalan, and Santa Cruz with daytime and nighttime pricing.
- [Interactive Venue Map](https://paddlebase.org/map): OpenStreetMap GPS navigation to every active venue.
- [3D Interactive Presentation Deck](https://paddlebase.org/deck): Spatial investor and guest pitch deck with explainer videos and unit economics.
- [PaddleClub Live Queue](https://paddlebase.org/paddleclub): On-court TV display boards and fair paddle rotation engine.
- [Coaches Directory](https://paddlebase.org/coaches): Verified instructor directory with hourly booking and direct payouts.
- [Community Marketplace](https://paddlebase.org/marketplace): Player equipment trading with verified local pickup.
- [Venue Point-of-Sale (POS)](https://paddlebaseowner.org): Automated court operations, cash and GCash reconciliation, and dynamic slot pricing for venue owners.
